actual: Real DEV 15-day single-Alpha and native multi-Alpha replay both fail deterministically on ordinal 3 while committing decision-mark evidence. Repository recursive upstream validation permits only the current and direct predecessor day identities, so traversal from day 3 through the typed day-2 receipt rejects the valid day-1 ancestor with ValueError: upstream artifact belongs to a different day run. Repair must preserve exact resolved request/range identity, typed successful DAY_RECEIPT predecessor linkage, cycle detection and fail-closed rejection of cross-run or unlinked ancestors; add a three-day regression for both valid and invalid chains.
closure_requirements: Preserve a typed predecessor day identity while recursively traversing same-day R3 evidence nodes.
Advance the permitted predecessor only through an exact typed DAY_RECEIPT edge and reject unlinked or cross-range ancestors.
Run the direct three-day regression, advisory historical-range module tests, L0, and module ownership verification.
Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
